note: 每道 Golden Case 的批准 SQL。执行环境: SQLite, 表已从 CSV 导入。日期口径: [start, end) 半开区间。

cases.sql: SELECT SUM(i.amount) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o USING(order_id) WHERE o.shop_id=1 AND o.status='paid' AND o.pay_time >= '2026-09-06' AND o.pay_time < '2026-09-13'

cases.sql_prev: SELECT SUM(i.amount) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE o.shop_id=1 AND o.status='paid' AND o.pay_time >= '2026-08-30' AND o.pay_time < '2026-09-06'

cases.sql: SELECT i.category, SUM(i.amount) AS amt, SUM(i.amount) - CASE i.category WHEN '服饰' THEN 600000 WHEN '家居' THEN 400000 END AS delta FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE o.shop_id=1 AND o.status='paid' AND o.pay_time >= '2026-09-06' AND o.pay_time < '2026-09-13' GROUP BY i.category

SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_time >= '2026-09-06' AND o.pay_time < '2026-09-13' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS curr, SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_time >= '2026-08-30' AND o.pay_time < '2026-09-06' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS prev FROM orders o WHERE o.shop_id=1 AND o.status='paid'

SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_time >= '2026-09-06' AND o.pay_time < '2026-09-13' THEN i.amount END) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o WHERE o.shop_id=1 AND o.status='paid' AND o.pay_time >= '2026-09-06' AND o.pay_time < '2026-09-13') FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE o.shop_id=1 AND o.status='paid' AND o.pay_time >= '2026-09-06' AND o.pay_time < '2026-09-13'
SELECT SUM(i.amount) FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE o.shop_id=1 AND o.status='paid' AND o.pay_time >= '2026-09-06' AND o.pay_time < '2026-09-13' AND i.category='服饰'

SELECT i.product_id, SUM(i.amount) AS amt FROM order_items i JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=i.order_id WHERE o.shop_id=1 AND o.status='paid' AND o.pay_time >= '2026-09-06' AND o.pay_time < '2026-09-13' AND i.category='服饰' GROUP BY i.product_id ORDER BY amt DESC LIMIT 1
